questions.question: What is the ocean?
options: The body of salt water that covers approximately 70.8% of Earth
The body of fresh water that covers approximately 50% of Earth
The body of salt water that covers approximately 90% of Earth
The body of fresh water that covers approximately 70.8% of Earth
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states: 'The ocean is the body of salt water that covers approximately 70.8% of Earth.'
Incorrect. The ocean is salt water, not fresh water, and it covers approximately 70.8% of Earth, not 50%.
Incorrect. The ocean covers approximately 70.8% of Earth, not 90%.
Incorrect. The ocean is salt water, not fresh water.
